matches.canonical_construct: Citrin is the mitochondrial aspartate-glutamate carrier that exports aspartate to the cytosol while importing glutamate plus a proton
matches.canonical_vignette: A 27-year-old man has recurrent episodes of confusion after carbohydrate-rich meals. During an episode, plasma ammonia and citrulline are markedly elevated. matches.canonical_lead_in: Which mitochondrial transport process is most directly impaired?

canonical_options.A: Import of ornithine from the cytosol into the mitochondrial matrix
canonical_options.B: Export of aspartate from the mitochondrial matrix in exchange for glutamate plus a proton
canonical_options.C: Export of citrate from the mitochondrial matrix in exchange for malate
canonical_options.D: Import of pyruvate from the cytosol into the mitochondrial matrix
canonical_options.E: Exchange of cytosolic ADP for mitochondrial ATP across the inner mitochondrial membrane
